review_scope: static: retail instructions and emitted candidate listing

checks.name: function_identity
checks.rationale: 102 bytes, 46 instructions, 13 blocks, 18 edges; both decoders and the emitted candidate report 13/18, score 1.000.

checks.name: cfg_match
checks.rationale: Block and edge counts match retail exactly (13/18). The two-byte unrolled comparison produces the same branch lattice rather than collapsing into a strcmp call.

checks.name: inlined_compare
checks.rationale: Retail's compare loop consumes two bytes per iteration with the sequence first-byte compare, end-of-string test, second-byte compare, advance by two, end-of-string test, and jumps back to the FIRST byte compare. The transcription keeps that exact order, including the second end-of-string test happening after the advance.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.rationale: One cdecl argument read at [esp+0x14] after four saved registers (ebx, ebp, esi, edi); it is the compared name and is never written.

checks.name: table_walk
checks.rationale: The outer walk keeps a pointer slot (edi) into 0x00546F04, reloads the next slot after each mismatch, increments a 1-based position counter (ebp) only on mismatch, and returns the paired word 0x00534A70[position] on a match; empty and exhausted table both return 0.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.rationale: Both exits are transcribed: the null-slot exits load EAX with zero (xor eax,eax), and the match exit loads the paired word. No error message is emitted by this routine in retail and none was added.

evidence: docs/fidelity/evidence/0x4EE970-data-extents.md section 22.3 Retail runtime evidence (spawn-suspended Frida, retail igi.exe alone, probe 63c9c669...): docs/fidelity/evidence/qfile-startup-20261024T195947Z/OBSERVATION.md.
limitations: Runtime OBSERVED on retail: 351 calls during startup+level-1 load, every call passed the string "r" and returned 1.

The table 0x00546F04 holds exactly four real strings then null - "r", "r+", "w", "w+" - and 0x00534A70 holds [1,3,2,3]. So this is a stream-mode lookup, not a device-name lookup: the placeholder name is semantically wrong and is retained only because rule 12 forbids renaming before full verification.
The declared 16-entry table extent is larger than retail's observed four entries plus null; the walk is bounded by retail's own null terminator, so behavior is unaffected.
No candidate parity: this is retail-only observation, so the record stays at STRUCTURALLY_VERIFIED and is not promoted.
